review: [Lobotomy E.G.O:: Red Eyes & Penitence] Ryoshu, or simply "Red Eyes Ryoshu," is a Charge ID with a lot of utility in her kit. Let's explore her skills first - but keep in mind that her Skill 3 possesses an enhanced variant (we’ll refer to it as Skill 3-1 for clarity in the review). Before we look at her skills, lets go over her mechanics first! Her unique charges, “Penitence” and “Red Eyes,” do not expire over time. Instead of gaining Charge Count, her passive randomly converts them into either “Penitence” or “Red Eyes”. If her second passive is active, she gains an additional charge of “Red Eyes” for each hit against an enemy with Bleed status. Do note that her own Bleed is on the later part of Coin, preventing her from gaining any extra Charge from it.
